g.text: Each step: live with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays;
empty with exactly 3 is born; the rest die.
Frames (Gen 1-4 are buttons; Gen 0 is a picture)
B) the same shape, moved one cell diagonally
Each step: live with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays;
empty with exactly 3 is born; the rest die.
Gen 1 · 5 live (× died, + born, dashed = gen 0)
Each step: live with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays;
empty with exactly 3 is born; the rest die.
In your four steps it was always 5 cells. At gen 4 it
was the starting shape again, one cell right, one down.
No rule says move: each cell counts its neighbours,
and the pattern travels. It is a glider, in Conway's
Game of Life, where patterns can compute anything.
